name: Gästehaus Maximilian
beschreibung:
Centrally and sunnily located in Soell, Gaestehaus Maximilian offers inviting guestrooms and apartments. Attentive personal hospitality ensures a restful holiday experience.

SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental, the Ahornsee swimming lake, and mountain footpaths are within easy walking distance.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Maximilian in Soell charms guests with cosy family warmth near the Wilder Kaiser.
